main_text.head: Lib. 8.
main_text.p: Habebant Vncos aureos. autem Stylobatas ex ære. Exod.26.36.37.&37.36.37.
Significabat autem gloriosa porta, fidelium corda gloriosa fic facta per fidem, ad Christum recipiendum. Psal.25.8.9. Apoc.3.20.
Tabulatum erat ex asseribus & transtillis, annulis aureis coniunctum, vt eo erigatur tabernaculum. Exod.28.28.29.&c.

Asseres, sunt e lignis Shittim, auro obducti, arrectarij longitudo cuiusq; decem cubitorum, latitudo, cubiti & dimidiari, cardinibus duobus scalari forma compositis, fabrifacti. Exod.26.19.20.21. ad recipiendum autem quemq; cardinem, factus est superne & inferne stylobata vnus argeteus. ibid. ver.19.21.25.
Pro plagis æqualibus, ad australem dextrorsum, viginti. Ad aquilonalem, viginti. ver.22.24.
main_text.l: Duo, gemelliparæ inferne, & superne, inditi annulo vno, vt sint pro duabus aulis angularibus.
main_text.p: Transtillum e lignis shittim medianum, in medio ipso afferum transcurrens, ab vno extremo ad alterum. ver.32.

page.notes: The braced diagrams were rendered as outlines; the first brace (Plagis/Angulis) is a scheme inside the text. Marginal printed letters on the facing page are fragments and were left out. Some words in the scan (e.g. "Pro angulis" block, "Transtillum") are slightly blurred; the text is copied as best read.
